name: external_validation_leppek_v1
purpose: The first external test of strand_rnafold_calibration_v1 against measured values it was not fitted on.
authorized_by: user, 2026-10-20: 'run it on the 123 held-out records'
status: PROTOCOL DECLARED BEFORE ANY CORRELATION WAS COMPUTED. The criteria below were written and frozen first, so the result can fail.

source.paper: Leppek K, Byeon GW, Kladwang W, et al. Combinatorial optimization of mRNA structure, stability, and translation for RNA-based therapeutics. Nat Commun 13, 1536 (2022).
source.measured_quantity: in-solution half-life in hours, from In-line-seq degradation fitted to a single exponential
source.redistribution: Not republished here. The protocol records the URL and hash so the dataset can be re-acquired; only derived metrics are published. This matches how the project treats RiboNN weights and Rfam sources.

why_this_dataset.quantity_match: strand_rnafold_calibration_v1 predicts in-solution half-life of purified RNA in buffer, in hours. This sheet measures exactly that. Every other dataset considered would have tested the model on a different quantity, where a poor result could not distinguish model failure from quantity mismatch.
rejected_alternatives: Eterna OpenVaccine: per-base degradation, not a transcript half-life, and 107 nt against our 1811 nt reference.
Saluki compendium: in-cell decay of endogenous transcripts, a different quantity.
Sample 2019 5'UTR MPRA: mean ribosome load, which would test the translation side instead.

training_overlap.finding: All 69 records in the calibration's training feature table are rows of this sheet. The calibration was fitted on a subset of this dataset.
training_overlap.evidence: 69 of 69 training rows match a paper row exactly on BOTH whole-sequence GC percent and half-life in hours.
training_overlap.join_method: exact numeric match on GC and half_life, because the training table uses barcodes such as X310001T1 while the sheet uses human-readable names, with zero overlap by name
training_overlap.join_risk: This is an INFERRED join, not a recorded one. Two independent float columns agreeing across all 69 records makes coincidence implausible, but the provenance link is reconstructed rather than documented.
training_overlap.consequence: Scoring the full 192 rows would be testing the model on its own training data. Only the 123 non-overlapping rows are used.
training_overlap.feature_window_confirmed: Because training GC matches GC computed from the FULL RNA_sequence column, the training features were computed on the full sequence, not on the RT-PCR amplicon window. This run therefore folds the full sequence. The paper also reports amplicon-window predictions, which this run does not replicate.

held_out_set.this_is_a_distribution_shift_not_only_a_: The held-out records are different reporters and span wider lengths and half-lives. If transfer is poor, the shift and the model cannot be separated with this data alone. That limitation is declared here, before the result is known.

prediction_procedure.folding: rnastable.ensemble_worker, ViennaRNA 2.7.2, RNA_Turner2004, 37 C, dangles 2, max_bp_span -1, min_loop_size 3, compute_bpp 1. The same settings as the frozen reference record.
features: energy_per_length = ensemble free energy per nucleotide
prediction_procedure.model: strand_rnafold_calibration_v1, without_alo arm, prediction = intercept + sum(coefficient * feature)
prediction_procedure.no_refitting: Nothing is refitted, rescaled or tuned. The frozen coefficients are applied as recorded.

declared_criteria.primary_metric: Spearman rank correlation between predicted and measured half-life over the 123 held-out records
declared_criteria.why_spearman_is_primary: The project permits ranking and correlation claims only; the calibration has no demonstrated absolute accuracy and this run does not create one.
secondary_metrics: mean absolute error in hours, reported for completeness and NOT as a claim of absolute accuracy
the same metrics on the 69 training records, as an upper bound rather than a result
declared_criteria.falsification: Spearman rho at or below 0 means the calibration does not transfer to records it was not fitted on. That outcome is reportable and will be reported.
declared_criteria.weak_transfer_threshold: rho below 0.3 is to be described as no useful transfer rather than as weak success

baseline_comparison.source: the paper's own predictor columns in the same sheet, on the same records
baseline_comparison.decision_rule: If the calibration's Spearman is below every one of these baselines, the refit adds nothing over published predictors and must be reported as such.
baseline_comparison.sign_note: The baselines are degradation or structure scores, so a baseline may correlate NEGATIVELY with half-life. Absolute Spearman is used for ranking the predictors, and the sign is reported.

declared_criteria.extrapolation_handling: Records whose features fall outside the calibration's training ranges are flagged, and the primary metric is reported both over all 123 records and over the in-domain subset only. Neither is presented as the headline alone.

what_this_cannot_establish: Absolute accuracy. A correlation is not a calibration.
That the calibration transfers to the project's own construct, which is 1811 nt and 64.4 percent GC, outside this dataset's length and GC ranges.
Anything about the translation side. RiboNN is untouched by this run.
Anything about in-cell stability, which is a different quantity again.
That a positive result validates the design workflow. The workflow's predicted differences between synonymous variants span a few percent, far below the spread tested here.
